label: Some holder of power for the actual contingents' joint absence is a willed two-way giver
paraphrase: Some being has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w and is, at w, a willed two-way giver: it exists at w, gives some being x being at w by a rational power of it, and at an accessible world where it exists with the same set-up does not give x being. It is not a CHANCE_3 giver given one power (controls, law 12). It does not say that the choice is contrastively explained, nor that the holder is GOD_4 or unique.
